meta.query: Which drugs frequently co-occur in combination studies for lung cancer?
meta.interpretation: Build a drug co-occurrence network of drugs given in combination (same arm) in lung cancer trials.
assumptions: Combination interpreted as drugs listed in the same trial arm.
14,625 trials match but only the 2,000 most recently started were fetched; values are computed from that sample.
467 of 2,000 fetched trials contained at least one linked pair.
Edge meaning: both drugs are listed in the same arm group of a trial (given in combination).
warnings: 14,625 trials match, above the complete_up_to ceiling of 5,000; the chart is built from the 2,000 most recently started trials and its values are marked sampled. Raise complete_up_to (up to 20,000) or narrow the filter.
212 fetched trials list no arm groups, so their drugs cannot be placed in the same arm and they do not contribute edges.
